context.note: Implementation of lib/letflow/design/iss0377-cross-platform-test-fixes.md (Part A + Part B) is complete and pushed. This is a test-infrastructure fix, not a tenant-data-path change -- no API route, migration, secret, or response-shaping code was touched. Review is expected to be lightweight per ORCH routing convention for non-tenant-data changes.

what_changed.part_a: AC7 describe block in plugin_handler_test.exs now derives the expected wasmex NIF loadable-artifact extension from :os.type/0 (case-mapped table: .so for linux/freebsd/darwin, .dll for win32, loud flunk on anything unmapped) instead of hardcoding 'native/wasmex.so'. Added a directory-listing fallback (native_artifact_check/2) when the fixed-name file is absent. The :external_resource assertion now branches on emptiness: non-empty asserts at least one entry ends in .rs (not every entry); empty falls back to asserting the compiled-artifact check instead of failing.
what_changed.part_b: scripts/test_parallel.sh gained a new Step 1.6 that sequentially (no concurrency) hardlink-copies (cp -al, falling back to cp -r) the already-compiled _build/test tree into N per-partition _build/test-partition-<i> directories before any partition is backgrounded. Step 2's partition launch now sets MIX_BUILD_PATH="_build/test-partition-$i" scoped to that single mix test invocation (not globally exported), alongside the existing per-invocation MIX_TEST_PARTITION.

security_review_scope.focus: Lightweight review only -- confirm: (1) no test credentials, API keys, tenant IDs, or other secrets are newly hardcoded in either changed file; (2) the new per-partition _build/test-partition-<i> paths in scripts/test_parallel.sh don't leak data across partitions (each partition gets its own distinct, non-shared directory seeded once before backgrounding -- no partition ever reads/writes another partition's build path) and don't persist sensitive data (these are ordinary compiled-artifact/build-cache trees, already covered by the repo's existing /_build/ .gitignore entry, and this design does not add any cleanup requirement beyond what req113's design already left out of scope for the shared _build/test tree).
security_review_scope.invariants_checked: INV-4 (tenant isolation) is not implicated -- these are host-local CI/dev build directories, not tenant-scoped runtime data. No new persistence, no new API surface, no new secret material.

context.toolchain_note: No Elixir/Erlang/mix toolchain was available in the ELIXIR-DEV sandbox for this run -- `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, `mix format`, the OQ-A1 empirical :external_resource check, and a real scripts/test_parallel.sh full-suite invocation could not be executed. Only `bash -n scripts/test_parallel.sh` (syntax-only) was run and passed. This is stated explicitly rather than claimed as a verified pass -- TEST-RUNNER or a host with mix available must run these before this change is considered verified.
